areas.title: Content
areas.summary: What a page says and shows.

areas.title: Layout
areas.summary: How a page fits a phone.

areas.title: Look
areas.summary: Color, type and the AI tells.

areas.title: Discovery
areas.summary: How search engines and agents read a site.

principles.rule: Show the least text that works. Give each card one picture, one short sentence and one action.
principles.why: Shaun called the hub Open source section busy and messy. A wall of text in a card is not acceptable.
principles.fix: Delete fact lists. Let a picture or a demo carry the detail. Keep the summary to one sentence.

principles.rule: Lead each project card with its own picture or looping clip. Put one line of text below it.
principles.why: Text-first cards read as a wall of words. Shaun asked for a visual that moves on each project.
principles.fix: Put the screenshot, clip or drawing first. On a phone, hide the browser bar of the preview.

principles.rule: Prefer a small interactive proof to a paragraph of explanation.
principles.why: A paragraph on net benefit asks the reader to trust it. A slider lets the reader see it.
principles.fix: Build the simplest control that shows the effect. The dcurves threshold slider is the model.

principles.rule: Show a demo as a short silent looping clip. Do not embed a video player.
principles.why: Shaun finds embedded YouTube players tacky.
principles.fix: Record MP4 and WebM clips from the live demo. Play a clip only while it is on screen.

principles.rule: Label every drawing that uses invented numbers: Illustration only. Not real data.
principles.why: A sample curve can pass as a real result.
principles.fix: Generate the drawing from declared sample values. Put the label in the caption.

principles.rule: Use details and summary for an FAQ, not a script accordion.
principles.why: The native element works without script and with a keyboard.
principles.fix: Style the summary. Keep its tap target at 44 px.

principles.rule: Check each claim against the project's own repository before you publish it.
principles.why: A card that says open source for a repository with no license is wrong.
principles.fix: Record the evidence in a table. Compare shared facts with a script.

principles.rule: Keep banned words in one JSON file. A test fails when public copy uses one.
principles.why: Brand wording drifts back unless a test holds it.
principles.fix: Scan page text and generated files. Name the allowed exceptions in the same file.

principles.rule: State no price, no star count and no compliance claim. Show a count only with its source and date.
principles.why: An unbacked number reads as a promise.
principles.fix: Keep a count in a data file. Refresh it with a workflow. Keep it out of discovery files.

principles.rule: Name no prospect and no customer on a public site without consent.
principles.why: A name on a public page leaks a sales lead.
principles.fix: Keep names in the private sales repository.

principles.rule: Never write the contact email in a discovery file or in structured data.
principles.why: Scrapers read these files.
principles.fix: Link the booking page or the contact page. Test the generated files.

principles.rule: Derive address, phone links, counts and years from one JSON file. Write prose with placeholders.
principles.why: Two copies of one fact drift apart.
principles.fix: Test the derived text against the source.

principles.rule: Mark sample data on screen wherever a result or a record shows.
principles.why: A demo record can look real.
principles.fix: Show a Sample data tag on the stage. Say it again in the result view.

principles.rule: Judge every page at 390 px wide, in dark mode, before any wider width.
principles.why: Shaun judges the sites on his phone. He called the first hub redesign terrible.
principles.fix: Walk 360, 390, 430, 820 and 1440 px, in both themes. Start at 390.

principles.rule: On a phone, center headings, chips and short copy. Keep the left and right margins equal.
principles.why: Content sat off-center on the hub and on shaunporwal.com.
principles.fix: Use one gutter token. Left-align a list or a long text inside a centered block.

principles.rule: Buttons in one row share one width, or stack at full width. Give each card one primary button.
principles.why: Buttons in ragged rows looked broken.
principles.fix: Set a minimum action width token. Let the row stack when it is too narrow.

principles.rule: A heading takes two lines or fewer at 360, 390, 820 and 1440 px.
principles.why: A heading that wraps to many lines looks broken on a phone.
principles.fix: Shorten the heading. Use the fluid title tokens.

principles.rule: No page scrolls sideways at any width.
principles.why: Sideways scroll means something overflows its frame.
principles.fix: Find the wide element. Wrap it, shrink it or clip it on purpose.

principles.rule: A project card fits the screen below the sticky header on an iPhone 15 Pro.
principles.why: Shaun said the cards were too tall.
principles.fix: Cut text. Put the picture first. Measure with the fit check.

principles.rule: Make each tap target at least 44 px wide and 44 px high.
principles.why: Small targets cause missed taps.
principles.fix: Pad the target, not the glyph. Add min-height and a negative margin to keep the row height.

principles.rule: Build the phone menu so no browser can stretch its rows. Do not use a grid in a tall panel.
principles.why: Some WebKit browsers stretch grid rows. No WebKit browser is installed here to test.
principles.fix: Use a flex or block layout. Test the CSS rule.

principles.rule: An open phone menu covers the page, locks scroll and makes the page inert.
principles.why: Shaun called the shaunporwal.com burger menu extremely unnatural.
principles.fix: Use an opaque full panel. Move focus into it. Close it on Escape and at the wide breakpoint.

principles.rule: Judge a page from tall tile screenshots, not from one full-page image.
principles.why: A full-page image is too small to show a flaw.
principles.fix: Scroll first so lazy images load. Shoot 900 px tiles at 360, 390 and 430 px, in both themes.

principles.rule: In the hero, the title comes first and the supporting text sits below it at every width.
principles.why: At 1040 px and wider the hub title sat low in its row, beside text that started higher. Shaun disliked it.
principles.fix: Give the title its own row. Put the text and the buttons below it. Run the layout check at 1040, 1280 and 1920 px too.

principles.rule: Set each form input to 16 px or larger.
principles.why: iOS zooms the page when a smaller input takes focus.
principles.fix: Raise the input font size. Leave the rest of the form as it is.

principles.rule: Make a card count divide the grid columns, so no card stands alone.
principles.why: A lone card in the last row looks unfinished.
principles.fix: Tie the count to the grid in a test.

principles.rule: Check each child of a bar against its parent.
principles.why: A parent box can fit while a child leaves it. The Bench Bridge top bar lost its theme button at 360 px.
principles.fix: List the bars in fit.json. Fail when a child ends beyond its parent.

principles.rule: Give each public site the same alive kit. It has pointer light, raised buttons, edge light, lit dots and a header edge.
principles.why: Static pages felt flat to Shaun.
principles.fix: Take colors and timings from tokens. Reuse the kit. Do not invent a new effect for one site.

principles.rule: Run hover effects only where a pointer can hover.
principles.why: A touch screen keeps the hover state after a tap.
principles.fix: Wrap each hover rule in the media query hover: hover and pointer: fine. Gate the pointer light once, with one query.

principles.rule: A visitor who asks for reduced motion sees a still page with all content.
principles.why: Moving effects can cause discomfort. A global 0.01 ms rule leaves a loop frozen in view.
principles.fix: Stop each animation. Hide each infinite loop, the pointer light, the edge light and the lit dots. Keep clips on their still.

principles.rule: Animate only transform, opacity, filter, color or shadow. No effect changes layout.
principles.why: A layout effect moves the content and costs paint.
principles.fix: List each effect and its property in the design doc. A test compares the list with the CSS.

principles.rule: Without script, show every section and every panel in full.
principles.why: A feature class that hides content fails when the script fails.
principles.fix: Let the script add the feature class. Remove the class after 3 s if the script has not started.

principles.rule: Do not animate the hero accent word. Use the accent color.
principles.why: Shaun dropped the shimmer on 2026-10-27.
principles.fix: Remove the keyframes and the timing token. Keep the color.

principles.rule: A demo clip stays on its still under reduced motion and when the browser asks to save data.
principles.why: A clip costs bandwidth and motion.
principles.fix: Load the clip only after those checks pass. Pause it when it leaves the screen.

principles.rule: On a button or card, set background-image or background-color. Never set the background shorthand.
principles.why: The shorthand removes the pointer-light image.
principles.fix: Write the longhand. A CSS test fails on the shorthand.

principles.rule: A client's business site stays calm. Use press and hover states and a gentle reveal. Skip pointer light.
principles.why: Shaun said a business may want to look conservative.
principles.fix: Keep the brand palette. Fix the AI tells. Skip the rest of the alive kit.

principles.rule: Give a slideshow a pause button, and stop it under reduced motion.
principles.why: WCAG 2.2.2 requires a way to pause moving content.
principles.fix: Add the button. Stop the timer when the visitor asks for reduced motion.

principles.rule: In CSS, write the :active rule after the hover rule.
principles.why: A later hover rule overrides the press effect on desktop.
principles.fix: Order the rules hover first, then active.

principles.rule: Give the main action one ambient cue and the tappable part one. Pulse no status dot on a demo.
principles.why: A pulsing dot implies a live connection.
principles.fix: List the cues in the design spec. Cut any cue beyond those two.

principles.rule: Animate the entrance of a region by opacity only.
principles.why: A moving box makes the layout checks measure unstable boxes.
principles.fix: Use opacity for arrival. Keep transform for press and lift.

principles.rule: Avoid the AI tells: gradient blobs, glow text, emoji icons, stat tiles and justified text. Also avoid three-color icon chips, three-part slogans and filler.
principles.why: Shaun calls such pages AI generated.
principles.fix: Use one accent. Write plain nouns and verbs. Cut filler.

principles.rule: Use one accent color.
principles.why: One accent tells the reader where to look.
principles.fix: Mark links, focus and the one primary action with it. A project color never colors a button.

principles.rule: Take every color, size and timing from a token file. A raw value in CSS fails a test.
principles.why: One source means one change.
principles.fix: Add a token before you write a literal.

principles.rule: Text pairs meet WCAG AA in the light theme and in the dark theme.
principles.why: A pair can pass in one theme and fail in the other.
principles.fix: Give every color a dark value. List each pair with its least ratio. Let a test check the list.

principles.rule: Do not install third-party design skill packs. Do not copy third-party component code into a public repository.
principles.why: The Taste Skill pack bans glows and shadows. That conflicts with the alive kit.
principles.fix: Read a pack for ideas. Turn an idea into a measured check of your own.

principles.rule: Show facts as a key-value list, not as a wall of stat tiles.
principles.why: Stat tiles make a long page and read as generic.
principles.fix: Use one list. Put a label and a value on each row.

principles.rule: Generate robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt, agents.txt, agents.json, meta tags and JSON-LD from one JSON file.
principles.why: Hand-copied facts drift apart.
principles.fix: Add a test that fails when a file disagrees with the source.

principles.rule: Set the canonical base URL to the host that serves the page without a redirect.
principles.why: A canonical link that redirects confuses crawlers.
principles.fix: Name the base URL once in the source JSON. Derive every canonical link from it.

principles.rule: After a deploy, fetch each discovery file from the live host.
principles.why: A dev server can hide a file that the live host serves.
principles.fix: Request robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt and .well-known/agents.json with curl.

principles.rule: Check the built site, not only the code.
principles.why: Build output can break in ways that the source tests do not see.
principles.fix: Read the output folder after each build. Fail on a missing canonical link, a second h1, a sitemap mismatch or an email address.

principles.rule: The default og:image must be a file that exists.
principles.why: A client site pointed its default social image at a 404.
principles.fix: Render the image from the data. Let the build check fail on a missing file.

principles.rule: Turn each taste complaint into a measured check.
principles.why: Words like busy or off-center are not repeatable.
principles.fix: Add the check to the site's check command. Run it on the old code and see it fail.

principles.rule: Walk the live site at phone width after each merge.
principles.why: Shaun judges the sites on production, not on a preview.
principles.fix: Check for overflow at four widths in both themes. Fetch the discovery files.

principles.rule: Run browser walks at the tailnet link, not only at localhost.
principles.why: A browser treats localhost as secure. That hides failures such as a missing crypto.randomUUID.
principles.fix: Use the link that npm run dev prints.

principles.rule: When the same fix applies to another page, propose it. Build it after approval.
principles.why: A fix built unasked on another page is a change of scope.
principles.fix: Name the page and the fix in one line. Wait for a yes.

principles.rule: Keep each site's own taste in its design doc. Keep the shared fundamentals in this skill.
principles.why: Two copies of one rule drift apart.
principles.fix: Add a new fundamental to this skill and to the site doc in one change. Run the sites check.

principles.rule: When CSS and a script repeat a media query, add a test that ties them.
principles.why: The two copies drift silently.
principles.fix: Test that both hold the same query.

principles.rule: Let the browser measure and pure functions judge. Unit-test the judging rules.
principles.why: The rules then need no browser to test.
principles.fix: Keep one pure budget module beside the runner.
